name: payready
description: Picks the right payment provider for your project and writes the integration — checkout, authenticated webhook, database schema, customer portal and refund path — with deterministic validators that BLOCK insecure writes as they happen. Three local engines back it: hook validators that cannot be argued with, a pure-function recommendation engine whose every rejection has a reason, and an event signer that proves a webhook handler rejects forged and replayed events. Knows the payment rails, currency exponents and e-invoicing obligations that decide real integrations, and always states whether it can build a given provider or only advise on it. Local-first, no account, no telemetry. Bilingual EN/ES.

strictMode.title: Strict mode
strictMode.description: Promote advisory validators to blocking. Turns the e-invoicing obligation notice and the slow-webhook warning into hard denials. Recommended once you are shipping to real customers.

defaultCountry.title: Default seller country
defaultCountry.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 code (MX, CO, US, ES…). Skips the first wizard question when set.

preferredStack.title: Preferred stack
preferredStack.description: Overrides stack auto-detection when your project layout is unusual. E.g. nextjs-app-router, express, fastapi.
